decode.metric: CUDA event span across pure fixed-batch decode, from execute_model to sample_tokens; include between-step idle gaps; exclude prefill/mixed steps

autotuning.screen: all legal original MixLLM candidates; HyGEMM 8 isolated candidates per path then top3 pairs under serial/concurrent
autotuning.refine: top 3 plans on every actual O/K/high count
autotuning.runtime: exact O/K/high key; ceiling token bucket
autotuning.timing: resident inputs, includes pack/output layout; 3x32 graph calls
autotuning.correctness: finite output and dequantized reference at sampled output/position coordinates

environment_control: No clock locking, cooldown, thermal admission or external-noise investigation. One GPU experiment process at a time. Preserve all stability attempts, accept first CV<=5%; otherwise mark unstable.
claims: Actual measured serving decode speed and WT2 PPL under this protocol; no claim of globally optimal tiling or matched output quality.
